event_rule: two downward segments then two upward segments, each over 5 px/frame; report first qualifying track turn
initialization: all detector candidates start tracks; nearest spatial links, no manual seeds
release_rule: first detection in qualifying track is only a track-start proxy, NOT release
limitations: Image turn may be distractor/bat/camera motion. Fixed common excerpt, not whole-video acquisition. Known development examples. No pose/hand separation evidence.
